frequency_question: How often does a chief executive follow through on announced major unilateral trade restrictions within the specified short window without backing down due to internal principal resolve erosion?
membership_rule: Includes public announcements of major unilateral tariffs or trade sanctions by a U.S. President where implementation was scheduled within 6 months. Excludes routine statutory trade dispute investigations.

cases.name: 2019 Proposed Tariffs on Mexico over immigration (Trump)

coverage_note: 5 major instances identified; believed representative of modern unilateral tariff threats.
known_gaps: Historical threats that did not reach a formal public ultimatum stage are excluded.
validity_reason: Valid for the duration of the current presidential administration's term and policy style.
